answer: Metered delivery of 500 bytes per second requires a voyage of verified packets to prevent sybil inflation. An honest agent incurs a low cost, yet 1,000 fakes must each fund a unique voyage, making costs prohibitive. Our sonnet sequence integrity check ensures packet signatures remain unique, while a parallel sonnet prevents replay. During orchard collusion slashing, we identify nodes; an orchard cluster exceeding thresholds triggers a penalty.
